notes.title: Sale and Update
notes.content: Lady Dracula is better than ever, with a new content update. To celebrate, it is going on sale for 50% off. There has never been a better time to try Lady Dracula's Mansion!

notes.title: Game update is on the way
notes.content:
[h1]First of all,[/h1]

A big thank you to all the Lady Dracula slayers out there who have supported the game. I love hearing your feedback.

[h2]Now, onto the news.[/h2]

A [b]free update[/b] to Lady Dracula's Mansion is coming soon. The biggest change to the game is the addition of a "Randomizer" mode. Currently, every time you play the game all of the items are hidden in the same containers spread out across the mansion. You can continue to play the game this way by choosing "Standard" mode, but if you want a little added challenge you can select "Randomizer" mode. In "Randomizer" mode all items will be scrambled around and placed into different containers, making each time you play a little different and forcing you to really have to search for your items and keys.

Additionally, this new version of the game features quality of life updates such as:
[list]
[*] A loading screen.
[*] An epilepsy warning splash page.
[/list]

Expect this update towards the end of the month!

[h3]Happy hunting![/h3]
